items.t: DeSoto County data center delay: Commission fails to approve 553-acre rezoning near Arcadia

items.t: South Korean prosecutor seeks death penalty for ex-President Yoon over martial law debacle
items.x: A South Korean special prosecutor on Thursday demanded the death penalty for ousted President Yoon Suk Yeol, ahead of an appeals court verdict on rebellion charges over his brief imposition of martial law in December 2024.
